features.description: Validate persistent migrations and preflight source, target, public interface and package graph.
acceptance_criteria: Valid migrations survive load and append across multiple moves; malformed entries are rejected.
Preflight rejects invalid target, missing source, destination collision and incompatible package dependencies without writes.
Nested target with a distinct module prefix maps to the correct file, declaration and canonical package import path.

features.description: Apply pkg move with a full C1 facade, both manifests, path dependency and syntax-aware import rewrites.
acceptance_criteria: Nested move updates the destination, both manifests, all eligible import sites and emits a complete facade and persistent migration entry.
Selective imports including constructors and renamed symbols, module aliases for functions and types, comments and string lookalikes behave as specified.
External old imports continue working, sequential moves preserve earlier entries and injected apply failure leaves the fixture consistent.

features.description: Gate source publish on the exact registry target version with PUB027 and classify the staged compatible move B.
acceptance_criteria: TST-PKGPAR-26 publish-order assertions: source-first or older target fails PUB027, exact target-first permits a minor; the local manifest survives refusal.
TST-PKGPAR-26 classification: verified new facade and equivalent signatures yield B across quality, inbox and Pub/Sub.
Later unchanged releases remain A, actual breaking changes remain C, and incomparable signatures remain U.

features.description: Validate import_rewrites and emit a C migration-request when the facade is removed.
acceptance_criteria: TST-PKGPAR-11: empty from and to paths fail validation independently; valid rewrites round-trip and legacy requests without rewrites still decode.
Source major emits one logical C migration-request per dependent with the manifest-derived paths, symbols, target name and publish-bound constraint on both channels.
Live or previously removed facades and unrelated C changes do not generate rewrite entries.

features.description: Carry validated rewrite data to the job and run the dependency-add, rewrite, lock, check and test workflow with AI fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Publisher payload reaches the wrapper through Pub/Sub, task persistence and dispatch config; legacy routing and trusted ingress are preserved.
TST-PKGPAR-12: the actual deterministic sequence adds the target before rewriting imports, locks, checks and tests the dependent, with zero AI dispatches.
TST-PKGPAR-27: C migration requests with non-empty rewrites route deterministic-first, every other C routes to AI, and failed deterministic check rolls back edits and dispatches AI once.

features.description: Verify the nested docparse split fixture over both releases and document the pkg move workflow.
acceptance_criteria: TST-PKGPAR-26: registry-backed minor release gains the transitive target in the dependent lock and warns with the moved path while old imports and constructor identity work on the evaluator and strict VM.
Major release applies its real request to the same dependent and works on both engines; record a 46-module scratch replay against the docparse_core split shape.

The package-publishing guide shows pkg move and the two releases; changelog included. make test-changed, make lint, make check-file-sizes, make check-changelog, make verify-examples and make check-doc-samples pass.
